summary: Implemented the Taskset Board attention workspace as a read-only schema addition plus reusable UI/design assets. The first Taskset Board viewport now renders an attention workspace before the full all-tasksets fallback.

source_changes.change: Adds taskset_attention_workspace/v1 with derived attention lanes for active claims, guarded recovery, evidence gaps, recent changes, and ready next actions.
Promotes componentTasksetQuickSwitcher and componentAttentionLaneFilter as ui_component assets and patternTasksetAttentionLane as a pattern_component asset.
Renders the attention workspace, quick switcher, lane filter, selected relation detail, and all-tasksets fallback on the Taskset Board.
Covers attention_workspace schema, lane ids, selected taskset, derived fields, active claim membership, and evidence gap reasons.
Covers new DOM hosts, JS render helpers, lane controls, asset calls, CSS selectors, and mobile wrapping anchors.
Covers the new component and pattern asset classifications and confirms the console renderer calls them.

design_tokens.notes: No new token definitions were required; CSS uses existing semantic color, spacing, radius, and type tokens.

one_off_for_now: Taskset Board fallback header copy remains local to the Taskset Board view because it appears once and does not yet justify a promoted asset.

acceptance.criterion: Attention lanes are visible before the all-tasksets fallback.
acceptance.evidence: HTML adds #tsboard-workspace before #tsboard-cards; Playwright metrics found workspace=true, laneFilters=6, laneCards=14, fallback=true.

acceptance.criterion: Lane membership is derived from named schema fields and includes visible reason labels.
acceptance.evidence: ui_state attention_workspace lists derived_from fields and lane items include reason and reason_fields; tests assert active claim and evidence gap reasons.

acceptance.criterion: Keyboard-first quick switcher supports known-target retrieval and selected/empty states.
acceptance.evidence: componentTasksetQuickSwitcher renders a search combobox, result count, selected chip, listbox results, empty state; Playwright typed TASK-AR-612 and selected the matching taskset with Enter.
tasksetSelectedDetail composes patternAttentionRelationPanel with taskset, claim, evidence, graph, and command state labels.

acceptance.criterion: Repeated surfaces are assetized or explicitly classified.
acceptance.evidence: ASSETIZATION_CLASSES now classifies quick switcher and lane filter as ui_component and taskset attention lane as pattern_component.

acceptance.criterion: API remains read-only and task.create proposal behavior is preserved.
acceptance.evidence: No ui_console.py route/write changes; existing tests for task.create proposal-only add-task path pass.
Playwright metrics at 390x844 reported docScrollWidth=390 and bodyScrollWidth=390.
